_about: Grid Paper Editorial #6 (r26, snippco 'Iman Gadzhi story', score 9) v2, 7 Oct 2026, matched frame by frame: the speaker CUT OUT on clean white paper, smaller and low in frame; tiny serif lead + bold sans key captions at the TOP; a red hand-drawn circle around the key word; a grey article page with one yellow-highlighted name; a deep green page with small serif words and one gold word; a single small question on white. Sound like the ref (demucs): a light keys bed ~9 dB under the voice (alif-match-c, distance 4.8), paper sounds on page changes only.

director.style: Grid Paper #6: an editorial story on clean white paper. The speaker cut out, small and low; typography at the top; red circles, yellow marker highlights, one deep green page. Smart, clean, premium.
director.ground: Cover every speaker stretch with ground beats paper 'white', grain false, sfx none (no vignette edge, so the page reads as one clean sheet); captions turn dark automatically.
director.captions: cluster at the top (fixedY 330): tiny serif lead words + ONE bold sans key in ink #141414; mixed case. Heroes = names and key nouns.
director.pages: Per 20 s: 1-2 stack scenes bg footage with ring: true on the key (the red hand-drawn circle), keyColor #D62828, y 230; 1-2 highlight pages (paper #F2F1EC, ink #8A8A8A, the key line box: true with boxColor #F2E14C, boxInk #141414); ONE green word page (wordpage bg paper, paper #0B4F1F, ink #F4F2EC, size 70, serif, gold: [the payoff word]); 0-1 small question wordpage on white (paper #FAFAF8, ink #141414, size 64, serif).
director.sound: music alif-match-c -9 dB; paper sounds on page changes (sound.paperIn); no caption whooshes.
director.sticker: Open like the ref: a STICKER PHOTO of the speaker (make_sticker.py <project> <orig time> <name>: their own cut-out frame with a thick white outline and a dark torn edge) as a popcard on the white page when they say their name or the hook, then the orange duotone copy for ~0.5 s (sticker-<name>-orange.png), defocus false, label = the name.
